text: [serious] What if Walter White... never got cancer? Albuquerque. 2008. The scan comes back... [whispers] clean. No tumor. No clock ticking. So Walt just... goes home. He never rides along with Hank. He never finds Jesse. There is no RV. No desert. No blue. No pizza on the roof. Instead, he teaches chemistry. For twenty-five more years. He retires a quiet, forgotten man. Nobody ever knew his name. Then, in the garage, Skyler finds a box. Inside: a formula. Ninety-nine point one percent pure. Never cooked. [dramatic] Because cancer didn't create Heisenberg... It just gave him permission.
